name: security-hardening-evaluation
description: JEV criteria for evaluating optimal security hardening actions based on vulnerability data, system posture, and historical remediation outcomes

options.description: Apply the available patch to fix the vulnerability
Upgrade the affected component to a newer version
Add compensating security controls (firewall rules, WAF, etc.)
Temporarily isolate the affected system from network traffic
Document and accept the risk, plan remediation for later

evaluation_factors: Vulnerability severity, exploit availability, and days since discovery
Current system posture including version, patch status, and affected dependencies
Historical success rates for each remediation action in similar situations
Time sensitivity and potential impact on users during remediation process
Risk of introducing new issues with more invasive remediation approaches
